benchmark_name: CLEF 2025 JOKER Task 2: Wordplay Translation from English into French
humanities_role_explanation: The task targets disciplinary translation competence: translating puns (wordplay) from English to French while preserving form and meaning, with a translation-studies expert doing the manual evaluation.
benchmark_modalities_explanation: Text-only: English punning jokes as input, French translations as output.
analytical_tasks_explanation: Pun/wordplay translation from English into French preserving both form and meaning; pun location annotations (words or phrases with multiple meanings) are used for evaluation of wordplay preservation.

general_purpose_benchmark.note: Single-task shared task on pun translation.

evaluates_generative_llm.note: Participant systems include LLMs such as o4-mini, Mistral medium, Qwen2.5-14B, Lucie-7B, Croissant, plus NMT systems (NLLB, MarianMT, mBART, Google Translate).

quantitative_metrics.note: BLEU, BERTScore, pun location-based metric, manual success counts.

summary: Overview of CLEF 2025 JOKER Task 2 on English-to-French pun translation, with nine teams submitting 52 runs. The authors evaluate with BLEU, BERTScore, a pun-location metric and manual expert evaluation, and show the location-based metric correlates strongly with manual judgments while BLEU/BERTScore do not.
key_findings: Best BLEU on test 43.33 (Skommarkhos_Lucie_SFT); best BERTScore F1 87.42. Best pun location metric 9.27% (dsgt_o4_mini_multi_agent_discriminator). Manual evaluation: 37.5% of translations preserved meaning and involved wordplay; best runs 74% and 72% success. Pearson correlation between manual scores and location metric 0.84. Rankings by BLEU/BERTScore differ substantially from manual ones; overfitting seen on training data.
dataset_size: 4,020 translations (1,405 training puns with 5,838 references; 1,682 test puns with 2,615 references)
facets_explanation: References are French translations by professional native-speaker translators, with manually annotated pun locations; multiple references per pun are accepted in BLEU/BERTScore. Manual evaluation was done by a single Master's student in translation specialising in wordplay.
results_explanation: Best test BLEU is 43.33 for Skommarkhos_Lucie_SFT; BERTScore F1 best 87.42. Manual success rate peaks at 74% (37/42) for dsgt_o4_mini_multi_agent_discriminator. No human baseline is reported and no gap kind comparison is given.

humanities_role.quote: The goal is to translate English punning jokes into French in a way that preserves, as much as possible, both the form and meaning of the original.

dataset_size.quote: consists of 1,405 instances of wordplay in English, with a total of 5,838 French translations
we collected 2,615 new manual translations of 1,682 distinct puns in English

evaluation_set_size.quote: we collected 2,615 new manual translations of 1,682 distinct puns in English

primary_evaluation_setting.quote: Participants used a variety of methods, including LLMs, commercial machine translation engines, out-of-the-box translation models, rule-based approaches, and various fine-tuning and training techniques

gold_source.quote: 5,838 French translations sourced from human professionals with manually annotated words or phrases with multiple meanings

answer_multiplicity.quote: We report mean values of BERTScore precision, recall, and F1 over all references.
